tools.name: search_indicators
tools.description: Searches the EconDash catalogue by keyword, for example GDP and growth, inflation, unemployment and wages, population, life expectancy, interest and exchange rates, government debt, trade, house prices, oil, gold and metal prices, stock indices, energy, health, education and internet use. Use it whe

tools.name: get_indicator_series
tools.description: Returns values of one indicator for one country or region. A call returns at most 30 annual, 40 quarterly, 120 monthly, 52 weekly, 250 daily values (about 30 years of annual data, 10 years of quarterly or monthly, one year of weekly or daily). Without years: the latest observed values. With start_ye

tools.name: get_full_series
tools.description: Returns the whole history of one indicator for one country or region, up to 1500 values per call, for people signed in to EconDash with full data access; other signed-in accounts get as many values as get_indicator_series. Needs sign-in to EconDash. Without years: the history up to the latest observ

tools.name: compare_countries
tools.description: Returns one value of one indicator for up to 20 countries or regions: for the given year, or the latest observed value in each country when no year is given. Each value has its own period and chart link; projections are labelled. Codes without data are listed separately.

tools.name: get_indicator_details
tools.description: Returns the description, unit, frequency, source, publisher, licence, attribution text, coverage in years and countries, and the time of the last data change for one indicator.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Lists the countries and regional aggregates in EconDash as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes with names. Regions include World Bank groups such as WLD (World) and EUU (European Union).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_indicators" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Searches the EconDash catalogue of economic, financial, demographic and social indicators by keyword. Returns up to 25 matches with the slug, name, unit, frequency, source and years covered. The slug is the input for get_indicator_series, compare_countries and get_indicator_details." → after: "Searches the EconDash catalogue by keyword, for example GDP and growth, inflation, unemployment and wages, population, life expectancy, interest and exchange rates, government debt, trade, house prices, oil, gold and metal prices, stock indices, energy, health, education and internet use. Use it whe"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
